profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at The Zebra
profile.summary: Curious and versatile software engineer with 9 years of experience in web application development and proficiency in a wide range of front-end, back-end and infrastructure technologies.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities
 - Create custom AI voice and SMS agents for handling common receptionist duties in healthcare clinics to reduce repetitive tasks
 - Plan and lead the creation of LLM-driven functionalities for company receptionist platform
 - Facilitate code reviews and sprint ceremonies

Achievements
 - Developed proprietary SMS platform for receptionists facilitating agents text communication, task executions, and routing to designated phone numbers according to location
 - Constructed knowledge base system for the receptionist platform that simplifies agent creation workflow
 - Strengthened platform visibility using Grafana monitoring and alerting, boosting team's capability to respond to issues

positions.title: Founding Software Engineer - Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities
 - Plan and lead the development of critical LLM-powered product offerings targeting various industries
 - Maintain, monitor, and optimize the company's underlying cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and local development environment
 - Facilitate sprint ceremonies (planning, kick-off, stand-up, retro) as well as the recruitment process of new engineers

Achievements
 - Established the company's mainframe infrastructure and automated deployment pipelines that enables continuous delivery of new features/fixes
 - Designed, developed, deployed, and maintained the company's 2 primary AI products in the Background Verification and Automotive space
 - Standardized the Engineering organization's code structure/pattern, database migration methods, local development environment, and data isolation strategy
positions.insights: Skills: NestJS · TypeScript · Github Actions · PostgreSQL · Redis · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · React.js · Prisma ORM

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities
 - Enable more vehicles to be connected to the Smartcar platform by building and maintain integrations to OEM servers
 - Research and implement internal tools to further improve the software development lifecycle

Achievements
 - Integrated Subaru and Volvo to Smartcar platform, adding 3000 new vehicles as the result
 - Centralized existing tools used for local development using Tilt, which enables engineers on the team to test changes against their local environment more efficiently and reliably
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · PostgreSQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Redis

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities
 - Lead the development of critical generative AI features, contribute in API functionalities while overseeing and delivering full-stack projects
 - Test, monitor, and improve the performance and stability of Jasper's core API and its functionalities
Provide mentorship and elevate the engineering team's performance

Achievements
 - Led the company's first major backend migration over to NestJS and graphQL, setting many new standards within the organization
 - Architected and implemented a multi-provider load balancing system that are able to withstand outages from AI vendors, which is currently leveraged by the company for both text and image generation
 - Architected and implemented a patented bulk content generation system that utilizes text extracted from uploaded documents as context
positions.insights: Skills: NestJS · TypeScript · Apollo GraphQL · Redis · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Next.js · PostgreSQL · React.js · Prisma ORM

positions.title: Senior API Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities
 - Design, build, and maintain REST APIs to suport the business needs
 - Write unit and integration tests to guarantee reliability of new and existing back-end services
 - Support customers during their integration with imaware API

Achievements
 - Developed and maintained a webhook service that tracks imaware test kits' real-time locations
 - Architected, built, and expanded a REST API that streamlined the acceptance of test results transmitted from lab partners
 - Standardized code structure/patterns and APIs development life cycle

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities
 - Scope and provide technical requirements for full-stack features for Verb platform as well as oversee and assist their development and improvement
 - Maintain, monitor, and optimize Verb platform's underlying cloud infrastructure
 - Review teammates' code to ensure new code is readable, extensible and held up to the team's quality standard

Achievements
 - Designed, built, and deployed an SSO API to enable Verb's OAuth 2 integration with SAML and Azure Active Directory
 - Migrated the platform's infrastructure deployment system from a home-grown solution to Terraform, benefitting from Terraform's support and community
 - Architected and implemented an internal content management system with dynamic search and role-based access control
